summary: The exact 20-page PDF gives coherent finite coefficient-selected rectangular observation bounds, a common-full-vector product obstruction, and a coexact weak-endpoint logarithmic lower family. Full proof reading found no main-invalidating defect. The value is a precise finite synthesis rather than a new general spectral principle. Minor revision should sharpen the comparison with classical partition algorithms, improve the dependency guide, and clean up presentation. Scientific importance is 3.25/10; overall_stars is its rounded value, not a separate quality score.
